title: Test scenarios
description: One file per endpoint (API) or feature (UI) in <layer>/<area>/: a suite of scenarios. Key order inside a scenario: id, name, automatedIn, role, knownIssue, steps.

tags.description: Tags for the whole suite, such as @products-api. The spec's test.describe is titled '<tags joined by spaces> - <suite>'.

id.description: Unique scenario ID: <LAYER>-<AREA>-NNN, with the codes from qa-agents-profile.yml (ids). The test title starts with it.

name.description: Scenario name (the test title after the ID).

automatedIn.description: Path of the spec that automates this scenario. Absent means not automated yet.

role.description: Login role of the test. Absent means the default user.

knownIssue.description: A known app bug this scenario hits; becomes the test's 'Known issue' annotation.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Checks are steps that start with 'Verify'.
